castleSourceObservation.search: Castle scans record ordinals zero through 500 and jumps to the append path once notenum becomes 501.
castleSourceObservation.append: The append path does not reject a full stream, so an additional record can be written after the last record the same workflow will search.
castleSourceObservation.result: A note appended beyond the searchable prefix can become unreachable and later appends can continue growing the working note file.

realmz2ChosenResult.recordOrder: preserve a separate stable ordinal for land and dungeon notes and reuse a free ordinal after deletion
realmz2ChosenResult.overflow: reject a new note transactionally before mutating session state
realmz2ChosenResult.restore: reject duplicate ordinals, out-of-range ordinals, mismatched map metadata, and over-capacity state
realmz2ChosenResult.presentationDraft: Revert draft is presentation-owned and does not claim Castle dialog-item cancel semantics
